video.title: AI欧腐《嫁给狮王后，前任兽夫们悔疯了/My Ex-Beasts Regret After I Married the Lion King》
video.desc:
其实给我看懵了
Elf Kael possesses powerful healing magic. He once saved five cursed beast‑folk including Derek at great cost, even breaking his own elven wings to lift their witch‑inflicted curse. After flower spirit Ethan arrives, he manipulates the five beast‑folk with tricks and enchanted pollen. Kael suffers betrayal, frame‑ups and cruel torture. Disheartened, Kael accepts the bonding proposal from Owen, the Lion King of the Forbidden Forest.
At the Sacred Tree ceremony, the five men swear never to bond with Kael, tri
精灵Kael拥有强大的治愈魔法。曾经，他不惜付出巨大代价，救下了包括Derek在内的五名受诅咒兽人，甚至折断自己的精灵之翼，只为解除他们身上由女巫施下的诅咒。
可花灵Ethan出现后，却用诡计和带有魔力的花粉操控了那五名兽人。Kael因此遭到背叛、陷害与残忍折磨。
心灰意冷之下，Kael接受了禁忌森林狮王Owen的结契求婚。
在圣树仪式上，那五个男人还发誓绝不会与Kael结契，试图彻底羞辱他……
